We are a driven and ambitious team tackling the Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge for the2026 NASA Space Apps Challengeunder the Sahiwal local event. We focus on building high-impact, immersive, and practical software solutions.

You should join our team if you are passionate about AI and others Let's build a stellar project together and make an impact!
summary:
🐑🚀 Space Sheep - Junior Astronaut
Join a little Astronaut and his cute Sheep friend on the Moon! Their rocket has landed, and their mission is to survive, explore, and train as Junior Astronauts in this fun HTML5 browser game for kids aged 7–12.
Powered by real NASA space and lunar science, Space Sheep turns real astronaut challenges into an easy, no-install adventure!
🎮 What To Do In The Game:
• Explore the Moon: Roam a beautiful lunar world inspired by NASA’s Artemis missions with the Astronaut and Sheep.
• Collect Lunar Ice: Gather vital water ice—just like real NASA astronauts need on the Moon for drinking water, oxygen, and rocket fuel.
• Gather Shining Stars: Collect stars across craters to boost your score.
• Complete Space Quizzes: Answer fun mini-quizzes to finish missions, earn astronaut ranks, and learn a new NASA space fact with every right answer.
• Endless Missions: One mission ends and the next begins—the adventure never stops!
✨ Key Features:
• Instant HTML5 play in any web browser (zero downloads)
• Real NASA lunar data & space facts tailored for kids
• Heartwarming Astronaut & Sheep friendship
• Relaxing background space music
• Easy, safe, play-and-learn STEM gameplay
Can you complete the most missions and become the greatest Space Explorer?
Play Now — Explore, Learn, and Keep Completing Missions! 🌙✨🎵
